d: Donald Trump has repeatedly insulted Somalia, calling it one of the worst countries in the world and questioning whether it is even a country. Yet, the same Somalia is now emerging as an important US military partner. Washington is backing the training of local Somalian forces to fight al-Shabaab and the Islamic State. The partnership also puts the US closer to the strategically important Gulf of Aden. So, why is America deepening military ties with a country Trump has repeatedly disparaged? And what is Washington seeking in this strategically important region? Palki Sharma tells you.
